name: Block Recursive Delete
description: Blocks recursive delete commands (rm -rf) on important directories like /, /home, /etc, and project roots
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block dangerous recursive delete commands
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'rm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|--recursive)\s+(~|/|/home|/etc|/usr|/var|/opt|\.)\s*$'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Recursive delete on a critical directory is not allowed."
  exit 2
fi
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/\s*$'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf / is never allowed."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
